Speaker: Thorne
Text: Halt. Fort Ironmaw is under Ironclad Authority jurisdiction. State your business.

Speaker: Kael
Text: I'm looking for passage through the Scorched Vents. I'm told you control access.

Speaker: Thorne
Text: The Vents are dangerous. Full of constructs gone haywire since the Rift. Why would a steamwright go there?

Speaker: Kael
Text: My daughter is on the other side of the Rift. I'll go through whatever I have to.

Speaker: Thorne
Text: ...I lost my squad to the Rift. Half of them, gone in an instant. If there's a chance to fix this — I'm in.
